A '''Theelin male''' was the biological partner of<ref name="SWI 67" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], and the pair gave birth to a half-Human and half-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]], [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]]. They abandoned their daughter, who was raised by a pair of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Musician/Legends|musicians]].<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rystáll Sant's father was first mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SETSB" /> Notably the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry would mention that he was Human and his partner was an "unknown [[Alien/Legends|alien]]."<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|rystall|Sant, Rystáll}}</ref> As that is the only source that mentions the father as a Human and the mother as an alien, this article, along with all linking articles, treats that as an error, and assumes the father was a Theelin and the mother was a Human.
